question: Explain the role of earthworms in producing vermicompost.
raw: O1: [S4] Earthworms play a crucial role in producing vermicompost. They are used in the decomposition process to break down vegetable or food waste, bedding materials, and other organic matter. [S5] Vermicast, the end-product of this process, is produced by the excreta of earthworms.
